description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Offline, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop. It serves to detect offline browsers by matching the user agent string against specific signatures and provides a method to return the browser type as 'offline'.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Offline
classes.description: A class to detect offline user agents by matching their signatures and returning the type 'offline'.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to determine if the user agent matches known offline signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a string indicating this user agent is 'offline'.
